about: Run on screen 1 fires it with the month. It reads the month's 8 rows, then runs three lanes side by side: prompts, announcements (with 4 spares) and the deep dive. It never waits for a person. Then it hands the month to you for editing.

groups.label: Prompt approval · its own flow · the loop does not wait

name: Research loop

nodes.action: When Power Apps calls a flow
nodes.expect: The trigger. Pressing Run on screen 1 creates the month's rows, then calls this flow with one input: the month. Every flow has to start with a trigger - this is the Power App pushing it in. Today it is a manual Start with a text box; it changes to 'When Power Apps calls a flow'.
nodes.title: Start: Run pressed on screen 1

nodes.expect: Reads the 8 Stories rows that Run on screen 1 created for this month (IssueLabel = the month), in Position order. Each row says its slot type and what you chose: the seed, the library prompt, or the Contoso file. The loop then fills them one at a time.
nodes.title: Get items: this month's 8 rows

nodes.expect: The month's Issues row goes to Researching, so the month picker shows a run is in progress and Run is disabled.
nodes.title: Set Status: Researching

nodes.expect: The prompt loop. Rows 1 and 2, one at a time. The line back into this node is where it repeats.
nodes.title: Apply to each prompt row (2)

nodes.expect: Right after the rows are read. Prompts, announcements and the deep dive run side by side, each in its own lane. None waits for another.
nodes.title: Split into three lanes, side by side

nodes.expect: Reads the library row named in LibraryId - the verified, unsent prompt you picked on screen 1. No agent: its title, summary, full prompt and subject are copied into the slot's row as they are.
nodes.title: Get item: Prompt Library (the one you picked)

nodes.expect:
Only for Agent writes one. No web search. Takes the topic you picked (or Agent picks) and the titles already sent, so it does not repeat one.
Shape, from September: title 7-9 words, summary 19-21 words, full prompt 250-365 words of HTML (Act as..., bold numbered headings, bullets).
nodes.title: Prompt writer

nodes.expect: Writes PromptTitle, Summary, FullPrompt (HTML), SubjectArea and SourceMode into the slot's row. From the library prompt you picked, or from a new prompt once it is approved.
nodes.title: Update item: Stories (prompt)

nodes.expect:
Announcement writer. Sonnet 5, web search on.
Takes the brief: window, seed, and the avoid lists (headlines and subject areas already used).
Gives 9 fields: publisher, headline, line, url, story_date, subject_area, evidence_quote, read_full_article, notes.
Works under Run node. Blocked in full runs until the tenant allows internet.
nodes.title: Agent

nodes.expect: Web search on, no knowledge. Takes the story and its url. Gives a verdict (Checked, Corrected or Disputed) and a note. Never sends the story back to the writer.
nodes.title: Fact-check

nodes.expect: Drops the story if the story date is empty or outside the window, the url is already in Stories, or a length is out of range. The writer gets one retry on the same seed.
nodes.title: Gates

nodes.expect:
Today: writes one complete announcement row to Stories (proven 23 Sep).
Plan: used only for the 4 spares, with Position blank. Rows 3-7 already exist and use Update item.
Story date wrapped in formatDateTime(trim(...),'yyyy-MM-dd'); GeneratedAt = utcNow() as an expression.
nodes.title: Create item (spare)

nodes.expect: From Contoso files: reads the Title, Url and Body (the article text) of the Deep Dive Sources row you picked. No internet needed.
nodes.title: Get item: Deep Dive Sources

nodes.expect:
From Contoso files: writes from the Body text, no search, no fact-check. Research: searches and reads the page, then goes to the fact-check.
Shape, from September: source 2 words, headline 8 words, body 48 words in one paragraph, one url.
nodes.title: Deep dive writer

nodes.expect: Checks a deep dive the agent found on the web. Skipped for an Contoso piece.
nodes.title: Fact-check (Research only)

nodes.expect: Writes Source, Headline, Body, SourceUrl, and the verdict when there is one, into row 8.
nodes.title: Update item: Stories (deep dive)

nodes.expect: The end of the run: when all three lanes are done, the month's Issues row goes to Editing and screen 2 can refresh. A prompt still waiting for approval does not hold this up.
nodes.title: Set Status: Editing

nodes.expect: If user selects "Prompt Library" they will also have selected the prompt to us / if the user selects "make my own prompt / they will pick from the "topics" list and there will be an agent that writes a new prompt
nodes.title: Prompt Library or Agent writes

nodes.expect: User will select from Contoso Deep Dive options, either a prepopulated list of Contoso Deep Dive materials (from a sharepoint) OR the Agent will build something
nodes.title: From Contoso Files or Research?

nodes.expect: Only after approval. The new prompt goes into the library with Verified on and its output as TestOutput. Sent stays off until Approve on screen 2.
nodes.title: Create item: Prompt Library (Verified on)

nodes.action: Start and wait for an approval
nodes.expect: Posts the new prompt and its output in Teams to whoever pressed Run, and waits - in this small flow only. The research loop has already moved on. Nothing is written until they approve.
nodes.title: Teams: approve the new prompt

nodes.expect: Runs the prompt the writer just wrote, on a sample, so the approver sees real output. The output is kept as TestOutput.
nodes.title: Run the new prompt once

nodes.expect: Yes: into the library (Verified on) and into the issue. No: nothing is written.
nodes.title: Approved?

nodes.expect: Not approved: nothing is written. The row stays empty, and screen 2 shows it so you can pick a library prompt instead.
nodes.title: Leave the row empty for you

nodes.expect: The announcement loop - this is where the agent runs over and over. Nine times: rows 3 to 7, then 4 spares. One at a time, so each brief's avoid list includes every story already found.
nodes.title: Apply to each: 5 rows, then 4 spares

nodes.expect: Rows 3-7 already exist, so they are updated. A spare has no row yet, so it is created with no Position.
nodes.title: Slot or spare?

nodes.expect: Writes the story and its verdict into its row in one write. Story date wrapped in formatDateTime(trim(...),'yyyy-MM-dd').
nodes.title: Update item: Stories (announcement)

nodes.expect: Starts the prompt approval as its own small flow and goes straight on to the next row. The loop never waits for a person.
nodes.title: Hand off for approval - don't wait

nodes.expect: Only after approval: writes the new prompt into its row. If the issue is already open on screen 2, a refresh shows it.
nodes.title: Update item: Stories (prompt row)
